world.now: The world right now for every player: the weather and the in-game clock. It updates by itself; press Refresh for the latest values from the server.
world.nowWeather: The weather every player sees now. If the automatic weather cycle is on, it changes by itself about every 10 minutes.

nowClock.text: The in-game clock, which runs faster than real life: an in-game hour passes in 2 real minutes and a full day in 48 minutes.
nowClock.example: If it is 14:00 now, 10 real minutes later it is 19:00

world.nowCycle: Whether the weather changes by itself and whether the clock is stopped. Change them in the Time and weather cycle section below.

weather.text: Changes the weather for every player at once, within seconds. Pick a kind of weather, then press Set weather.
weather.example: Pick Rain for a night event
weather.undo: Yes, pick another weather and set it

group.clear: Clear, sunny skies with the best view. Good for normal play and photos.
group.clouds: Cloudy skies or fog that cuts the view. Thick fog makes hunting and chases harder.
group.rain: Rain, thunder or hail: darker skies and a storm you can hear. Good for night or mystery events.
group.snow: Snow and blizzards. Strong ones like Whiteout drop the view to almost nothing, so use them briefly.
group.other: Special skies like Sandstorm and Hurricane. Very strong; best for a short event.

applyWeather.text: Sets the chosen weather for every player now. If the automatic cycle is on, it may change again in about 10 minutes.
applyWeather.undo: Yes, pick another weather and set it

time.text: Sets the in-game clock for every player; the sun and moon move with it. Time keeps running afterwards.

hour.text: The hour from 0 to 23, on a 24-hour clock.

world.presets: Fills in a ready time of day. Nothing changes in the game until you press Set time.

applyTime.text: Sets the chosen time for every player now. The sky changes at once and the clock runs on from there.

world.announce: Sends a message every online player sees at the top centre of the screen, under the compass, for the time you choose, and a line in the chat. You can take it off screens early with Hide announcement.

announceText.text: The announcement text, up to 300 characters. Keep it short and clear; players see it exactly as you write it.
announceText.example: Restart in 5 minutes, save your things

world.template: Puts this ready text in the announcement box. You can edit it first; nothing is sent until you press Send to everyone.
world.preview: This is how players get the announcement: white text at the top centre under the compass for the time you chose, and a line in the chat. The preview sends nothing.

send.text: Sends the announcement to every online player now and saves it in the admin log under your name. You confirm before it goes.
send.undo: Partly: Hide announcement takes it off every screen, but the chat line stays

world.cycle: Controls the weather script itself: freeze the clock, the automatic weather cycle and a blackout. Changes reach every player at once.

freezeTime.text: Stops the in-game clock where it is, so day and night stop changing. Useful for events and photos.
freezeTime.undo: Yes, turn it off to let the clock run again

dynamicWeather.text: On: the weather changes by itself about every 10 minutes. Off: the weather you pick stays until you change it.
dynamicWeather.undo: Yes, turn it on or off any time

blackout.text: Turns off artificial lights in the world, like town lights and lamps, so nights get truly dark. For dark events.
blackout.undo: Yes, turn it off to bring the lights back

world.history: The latest weather, time and announcement changes from this panel: who changed what and when. Handy when you want to know who changed the sky.
world.missing: We could not read the weather from the server; the weather script w_weathersync is probably stopped. Start it from Resources and come back.

duration.text: How long the announcement stays on screen. Pick seconds or minutes, from 3 seconds up to 30 minutes. Players who join while it runs see it for the time left.
duration.example: 2 minutes for an event that starts soon

clear.text: Takes the announcement that is on screen now off every player's screen at once. The chat line stays.
clear.undo: No, but you can send it again

world.timeResult: After this it will be %s (%s) for every player

tpl.restart5: Restart in 5 minutes, save your things
tpl.maintenance: Short server maintenance, back in a few minutes
tpl.event: Event now in Valentine, everyone is welcome

world.previewEmpty: Write a text to see the preview here.
world.confirmText: This announcement will show now for everyone online (%s) for %s.

cycleDesc.freezeTime: The clock stops where it is.
cycleDesc.dynamicWeather: The weather changes by itself about every 10 minutes.
cycleDesc.blackout: Town lights and lamps go dark.

world.missing: The weather cannot be read right now
